title: Turning Earth
conditionDescription: Very high futureMomentum, strong earthHealth, repeated collective and regenerative choices.
summary: The golden cracks do not vanish. They become lines of force. What once looked like damage begins to tip toward a shared, living future.
earthVoice: I was changed when care stopped being occasional and became a pattern.
reflectionPrompt: Which repeated action could become a turning point where you live?

title: Collective Earth
conditionDescription: High communityCare and justice, with shared action stronger than individual repair alone.
summary: Lights cross the surface like promises kept in public. The Earth is still wounded, but the wounds are no longer carried alone.
earthVoice: When hands found each other, I felt the distance between harms begin to shorten.
reflectionPrompt: Who needs to be connected before repair can last?

title: Blooming Earth
conditionDescription: High biodiversity and earthHealth, with planting, restoration, composting, or protection repeated.
summary: Green returns first as a trace, then as cover, then as bloom. The repaired places begin to feed the living ones beside them.
earthVoice: Give a damaged place time, and it may answer in roots, rivers, and flowers.
reflectionPrompt: What living system near you needs patient return?

title: Repairing Earth
conditionDescription: Moderate recovery, lowered waste, and visible repair without enough collective momentum to tip the system.
summary: Green stitches cross the old fractures. The Earth is not healed, but the wound is being held open to care instead of neglect.
earthVoice: Mending is not the end of harm. It is the refusal to leave harm unattended.
reflectionPrompt: What broken pattern could be mended before it spreads?

title: Fragile Earth
conditionDescription: Mixed choices, low extremes, and an unresolved path that leaves the Earth cracked but still responsive.
summary: The pale surface holds its cracks like unfinished sentences. Nothing has fully tipped. Nothing is beyond response.
earthVoice: I am still listening from inside the fracture.
reflectionPrompt: What would move this fragile balance toward repair?

title: Warming Earth
conditionDescription: High temperature or waste pressure, with delay, consumption, or extraction present but not yet total collapse.
summary: Orange heat gathers in the cracks. The Earth has not fallen apart, but pressure is becoming visible everywhere.
earthVoice: Heat is one way I tell the story you keep postponing.
reflectionPrompt: Which pressure must be lowered first?

title: Collapsing Earth
conditionDescription: Very low earthHealth, high waste, high temperature, or repeated negative choices.
summary: The surface darkens into ash and ember. Collapse does not arrive as one event; it is built from repeated harms left unbroken.
earthVoice: I warned you in heat, silence, fracture, and dust.
reflectionPrompt: What repeated pattern would need to stop first?
